profile.headline: Semiconductor Manufacturing Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Process Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the semiconductors industry. Skilled in Photolithography, SolidWorks, LabVIEW, Matlab, and Semiconductors. Strong operations professional with a Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) focused in Mechanical Engineering from University of California, Berkeley.

positions.title: Mask Engineer - Non-volatile Memory Solutions Group (NSG)
Graduate Student Researcher
positions.description:
• Design and model an integrated sealing system for the MEMS rotary engine power system to be fabricated from single crystal Silicon using numerical analysis and CosmosWorks FEA software
• Design photolithography masks for engine components using SolidWorks 3D modeling software
• Design fabrication process flow, including photolithography, oxide deposition, and etching, for micromachining of engine components
• Fabricate engine components by implementing bulk Silicon micromachining processes including photolithography and deep reactive ion etching (DRIE)
• Develop process for optimum fabrication tolerances by implementing the Taguchi method for design of experiments
• Regularly report to funding agency and industrial advisory board on progress and milestones

positions.title: Graduate Student Instructor
positions.description:
• Plan discussion sections on topics in design, fabrication, and testing of microelectromechanical systems
• Coordinate electronic access of supplemental course materials via the world wide web
• Compile layouts for a single mask Silicon-on-insulator DRIE process

positions.title: Engineering Intern & Draftsperson
positions.description:
• Produced structural, hydraulic, and electrical blueprints for fabrication of agricultural harvesters
• Developed designs and design modifications with welder/fabricators and machinists
• Contributed to the design of six harvesting machines
